shows.title: Tales of Urban Hysteria is an evening of four short plays by award-winning playwright Mark Borkowski.
shows.description: Urban Angels & The Onomatopoeia Theatre Company Present Four short plays by Mark Borkowski about fear, obsession, loss, redemption, and how we live with what haunts us. Sometimes frightening. Sometimes funny. Sometimes heartbreaking. These are stories about people searching for connection, meaning, forgiveness — and learning how to live with what haunts them. The evening includes: Savage Ink Directed by Thomas R. Gordon. With Kate T. Billingsley, Philip Cruise & Richard-John Seikaly. The Kids Are Awake Directed by Joe Danisi. With Sarah Robertson, Jesse Kinstler & Judy Jerome. Our Lady of the Towers Directed by Mark Borkowski. With Karen Giordano, Antone Pagan & Mary Anisi A Gravedigger's Tale Directed by Mark Borkowski. With Ron Scott, Santo Fazio, Clara Tristan & Conor Andrew Hall. Location: Gene Frankel Theatre 24 Bond Street, New York, NY 10012 When: October 21–24 & October 28–31, 2026 7:00 PM General admission seating.
